description: Canonical tool manifest for Jenny. Managed sidecar and builtin MCP surfaces consume this schema v2 as the authoritative descriptor source for Jenny-owned tools.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read UTF-8 text, transparently decoding a leading UTF-8 BOM. Markdown headings can select bounded document sections; PDF page selection is feature-gated behind hidden image/PDF read support. When rich file tools are enabled, .docx/.xlsx/.xlsm/.pptx/.ipynb (and PDF text when image reads are off) return bounded structured inspection instead of raw bytes.

config_schema.label: Image and PDF reads
config_schema.help_text: Allow read_file to expose image and PDF page-read affordances.

config_schema.label: File tools
config_schema.help_text: Send-time preference: allow the model to use workspace file tools (read, write, edit, glob, grep, list). Availability still requires a workspace root.

config_schema.label: Rich file tools
config_schema.help_text: Allow read_file to return bounded structured inspection for PDF, spreadsheet, document, presentation, and notebook files.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative file path to read.

offset.description: 0-based line offset to start reading from.

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read.

pages.description: Optional PDF page selection such as '1-3,5' when image/PDF reads are enabled.

headings.description: Markdown headings to read in document order. Mutually exclusive with offset, limit, and pages.

tools.name: operation_status
tools.description: List active or interrupted durable operations with verification guidance; this status view never authorizes re-execution.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Write UTF-8 content to a file, preserving an existing UTF-8 BOM by default. Set normalize_bom to remove it deliberately. To overwrite an existing file, first read it fully with read_file in this conversation; the raw-byte snapshot is applied automatically.

result_metadata.workspace_change_set: Bounded v1 summary: schema_version, change_set_id, state, operation_sequences, protected, partially_undoable, warning. Contains no authoritative-store or recovery-object paths.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative file path to write.

purpose.description: One short plain sentence explaining what will happen in the user's terms.

normalize_bom.description: Remove an existing UTF-8 BOM instead of preserving it.

expected_read_snapshot.description: Snapshot metadata from a prior full read_file call when overwriting an existing file.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Apply a targeted search-and-replace edit to an existing UTF-8 file, preserving an existing UTF-8 BOM by default. Set normalize_bom to remove it deliberately. Pass an edits array to apply several search-and-replace pairs to the same file in one atomic write; each item matches against the text produced by the previous one.

result_metadata.workspace_change_set: Bounded v1 summary: schema_version, change_set_id, state, operation_sequences, protected, partially_undoable, warning. Contains no authoritative-store or recovery-object paths.

file_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative file path to edit.

old_string.description: The text to find and replace.

replace_all.description: Replace all exact matches instead of requiring a unique match.

purpose.description: One short plain sentence explaining what will happen in the user's terms.

edits.description: Several search-and-replace pairs applied to the file in order as one atomic write. Mutually exclusive with top-level old_string/new_string; each item matches against the text produced by the previous item.

old_string.description: The text to find and replace.

replace_all.description: Replace all exact matches of this item instead of requiring a unique match.

normalize_bom.description: Remove an existing UTF-8 BOM instead of preserving it.

expected_read_snapshot.description: Snapshot metadata from a prior full read_file call for the target file.

tools.name: delete_file
tools.description: Delete a workspace file or directory. The target is moved to .jenny/trash (reversible) rather than permanently erased. Deleting a directory requires recursive: true.

result_metadata.workspace_change_set: Bounded v1 summary: schema_version, change_set_id, state, operation_sequences, protected, partially_undoable, warning. Contains no authoritative-store or recovery-object paths.

path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path of the file or directory to delete.

recursive.description: Required (true) to delete a directory and its contents.

purpose.description: One short plain sentence explaining what will happen in the user's terms.

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename up to 100 workspace files or directories as one validated batch. Missing destination parent directories are created. The whole batch is validated before any move begins.

result_metadata.workspace_change_set: Bounded v1 summary: schema_version, change_set_id, state, operation_sequences, protected, partially_undoable, warning. Contains no authoritative-store or recovery-object paths.

moves.description: Files or directories to move. Every destination is the full target path, including the final file or directory name.

source.description: Existing absolute or workspace-relative source path.

destination.description: Absolute or workspace-relative full destination path.

source.description: Single-pair convenience form: existing source path.

destination.description: Single-pair convenience form: full destination path.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing destination after checkpointing it. Defaults to false.

purpose.description: One short plain sentence explaining what will happen in the user's terms.

tools.name: glob_files
tools.description: Find files matching a glob pattern, including bounded shell-free brace alternatives such as *.{js,css,html}.

pattern.description: Glob pattern to match. Comma-separated brace alternatives expand to at most 32 patterns.

tools.name: list_dir
tools.description: List the contents of a directory. Files show a human-readable size (4.2K, 128.5M); directories do not.

path.description: Directory path to list. Defaults to workspace root.

tools.name: workspace_manifest_read
tools.description: Read Jenny's generated runtime workspace manifest for high-level project orientation, recent files, entry points, and git status.

tools.name: grep_search
tools.description: Search file contents using a regular expression.

include_glob.description: Optional glob to filter searched files. Comma-separated brace alternatives expand to at most 32 patterns.

ignore_case.description: Whether to ignore case when matching the regex.

context_lines.description: Number of context lines to include around each match.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

tools.name: knowledge_search
tools.description: Search the user's registered knowledge folders for a regular expression. Returns matching lines plus kb:N source references.

root.description: Optional registered root to restrict the search to (folder name or full path). Mutually exclusive with path.

path.description: Optional directory or file inside a registered folder to scope the search to (e.g. project-x/sub). Mutually exclusive with root.

include_glob.description: Optional glob to filter searched files.

ignore_case.description: Whether to ignore case when matching the regex.

context_lines.description: Number of context lines to include around each match.

max_results.description: Maximum number of matches to return.

tools.name: knowledge_view
tools.description: Read a document from the registered knowledge folders. Text files are paginated by line; pdf/docx/xlsx/pptx/ipynb are converted to text via the rich-file inspectors.

path.description: Document path as returned by knowledge_search (registered folder name followed by the relative path).

offset.description: Line offset to start reading from (text files).

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return (text files).

tools.name: knowledge_exec
tools.description: Run a bounded read-only listing operation over the registered knowledge folders: ls, tree, or find.

op.description: The read-only listing operation to run.

path.description: Optional path scope (registered folder name followed by the relative path).

max_entries.description: Maximum number of entries to return.

tools.name: git_status
tools.description: Show the working tree status of the git repository.

cwd.description: Optional absolute or workspace-relative repository path; omit to use the workspace root.

tools.name: git_log
tools.description: Show recent git commit history.

cwd.description: Optional absolute or workspace-relative repository path; omit to use the workspace root.

tools.name: git_diff
tools.description: Show a bounded git diff for the working tree or index.

cwd.description: Optional absolute or workspace-relative repository path; omit to use the workspace root.

staged.description: Show staged changes instead of unstaged changes.

ref.description: Optional git ref to diff against.

path.description: Optional file or directory filter relative to the chosen cwd.

tools.name: git_show
tools.description: Show a bounded commit patch, or bounded UTF-8 file content at ref:path when path is supplied. Git runs argv-only, so refs containing ^ are safe from Windows cmd.exe escaping.

cwd.description: Optional absolute or workspace-relative repository path; omit to use the workspace root.

ref.description: Commit ref to show. Defaults to HEAD.

path.description: Optional file path inside the selected repository. When present, returns file content at ref:path.

tools.name: workspace_change_baseline
tools.description: Capture an opaque, in-memory Git worktree baseline for the current session and repository.

cwd.description: Optional absolute or workspace-relative repository path; omit to use the workspace root.

tools.name: workspace_change_delta
tools.description: Compare Git-observable worktree state with a session baseline, including session-created paths later removed.

cwd.description: Optional absolute or workspace-relative repository path; omit to use the baseline repository.

tools.name: web_search
tools.description: Search the web for information.

config_schema.label: Web tools
config_schema.help_text: Enable web_search and fetch_url for live web lookup.

allowed_domains.description: Only return results from these domains.

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Fetch content from a URL and return sanitized text or markdown. This is the correct tool for reading any external web page, including pages found via web_search.

purpose.description: One short plain sentence explaining what will happen in the user's terms.

tools.name: create_artifact
tools.description: Create a session-scoped scratch document or script under .jenny/artifacts for plans, notes, or helper scripts. If the content is HTML (e.g. a .html/.htm file name or extension, or language "html"), it renders as a live, network-isolated sandboxed in-app preview — this is the supported way to show HTML/JS to the user in-app.

purpose.description: One short plain sentence explaining what will happen in the user's terms.

artifact_kind.description: Whether to create a scratch document or script.

content.description: The full UTF-8 text content to write.

language.description: Optional language hint such as markdown, javascript, or python.

extension.description: Optional file extension override such as .md or py.

tools.name: worktree_list
tools.description: List Git worktrees for the configured workspace root, combining Git-discovered state with Jenny registry entries.

config_schema.label: Worktree tools
config_schema.help_text: Enable Electron-local worktree_list, worktree_create, worktree_select, and worktree_delete tools for isolated Git worktree setup.

tools.name: worktree_create
tools.description: Create a local Git worktree in a guarded parent directory without fetching remotes or changing the active workspace root.

purpose.description: One short plain sentence explaining what will happen in the user's terms.

name.description: Human-readable worktree name. Used to derive the target folder and default jenny/<slug> branch.

branch.description: Optional new local branch name. Defaults to jenny/<slug-from-name>.

base_ref.description: Optional local base ref for git worktree add. Defaults to HEAD.

tools.name: worktree_select
tools.description: Select a registered Git worktree as the active tools workspace root after validation.

purpose.description: One short plain sentence explaining what will happen in the user's terms.

worktree_id.description: Registry id returned by worktree_list or worktree_create.

tools.name: worktree_delete
tools.description: Delete a clean registry-owned Git worktree, refusing dirty or path-ambiguous targets.

purpose.description: One short plain sentence explaining what will happen in the user's terms.

worktree_id.description: Registry id returned by worktree_list or worktree_create.

tools.name: automation_list
tools.description: List read-only time-based automations from Jenny scheduler records.

tools.name: automation_read
tools.description: Read one Jenny automation definition and bounded run history by automation id.

automation_id.description: Automation id returned by automation_list, such as automation:project_health.

tools.name: workspace_present
tools.description: Request that the user's workspace IDE presents a file: a rendered preview, the dependency File Map, or one recorded Jenny change diff. Presentation is one-shot and may be deferred while the user is actively working.

path.description: Workspace-relative file path. Required for view="preview" and view="change_diff"; optional for view="file_map".

change_id.description: Optional recorded change id used to select the exact change when view="change_diff".

tools.name: preview_test
tools.description: Load one workspace HTML file in a hidden, network-isolated sandbox and report what happened: render state, console errors, and page errors, optionally after bounded click/type interactions and at a chosen viewport. Read-only and one-shot; it never navigates off the file, reaches the network, or evaluates caller scripts.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the .html/.htm file to test.

viewport.description: Viewport preset for responsiveness checks. Default desktop (1280x800); mobile is 390x844, tablet 820x1180.

wait_ms.description: Settle time in milliseconds after load (and after events) before results are read. 0-5000, default 500.

screenshot.description: Attach a PNG screenshot of the rendered page as a session artifact. Default false.

events.description: Up to 10 bounded interactions applied in order after load. Each item: {action: "click"|"type", selector, text?, press_enter?}. Selector misses are reported per event, not fatal.

tools.name: verify
tools.description: Run one of the user's own saved Test Runner configurations and report the verdict. action "list" shows the saved configurations with each one's last status; action "run" executes one by config_id and returns pass/fail counts plus the failing output; action "gate" runs whichever one the user designated as the verification gate. You cannot create, edit, or compose a command — only choose which saved configuration to run — so prefer this over run_command for running this project's tests.

action.description: "list" to see the saved test configurations, "run" to execute one by config_id, "gate" to run whichever one the user designated as the verification gate.

config_id.description: Required for action "run": the id of a saved test configuration, as reported by action "list".

tools.name: home
tools.description: Read and update the user's Home surfaces: list calendar events, create/update/delete calendar events and reminders, and read the Home scratchpad. Every write is attributed to Jenny and one-click undoable from Home; deletes do nothing until a second call carries confirm=true. The scratchpad is read-only.

id.description: Existing event or reminder id. Omit on an upsert to create a new record.

start.description: Event start as a local wall-clock "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM" string (no timezone).

end.description: Event end as a local wall-clock "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM" string. Defaults to 30 minutes after start.

category.description: Calendar category, which also selects the event color.

prompt.description: Optional text to raise with the user when the reminder is surfaced.

remind_at.description: Reminder time: "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM" for a one-shot, or "HH:MM" for a daily reminder.

range_start.description: Optional local "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM" lower bound for calendar_list.

range_end.description: Optional local "YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM" upper bound for calendar_list.

confirm.description: Required true to actually perform a delete. Without it the tool only reports what would be deleted.

tools.name: task_board
tools.description: Add, update, complete, or list durable model-authored tasks in the persisted Open Loops store. Mutations target one task id; add generates and returns a new id. The list action returns only agent_task records. When you finish work that a task tracks — including a session started from a task, whose brief names its task id — call complete with that id. Do not leave a finished task open.

action.description: Which identity-addressed task-board operation to perform.

id.description: Existing task id. Required for update and complete; omit for add.

status.description: Optional Open Loops status. Use complete to check off a task.

tools.name: delegate
tools.description: Delegate one context-heavy read-only investigation or two to three independent investigations. The harness chooses single, sequential, or parallel execution and returns ordered compact results.

config_schema.label: Delegated repository research
config_schema.help_text: Bounded read-only repository research. Delegation may add model cost and latency; concurrency depends on the active engine profile.

tasks.description: One to three ordered, self-contained read-only investigation tasks.

tools.name: python_execute
tools.description: Execute Python code for data analysis, calculations, and visualization. Returns text output plus optional inline charts and tables. Code runs with its working directory set to the workspace root when one is configured, so relative paths resolve against the workspace, and JENNY_WORKSPACE_ROOT names that root. Without a workspace it runs in a temporary directory that is deleted after the call. Write generated files to the directory named by JENNY_OUTPUT_DIR.

config_schema.label: Python execution
config_schema.help_text: Enable resource-bounded local Python execution on supported Windows builds. It is not a filesystem or network sandbox: executed code can read and write the user's files with the same reach as the app itself. Every call requires individual approval.

purpose.description: One short plain sentence explaining what will happen in the user's terms.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run a shell command via cmd.exe on Windows or /bin/sh elsewhere. Windows cmd.exe treats ^ as an escape; prefer git_show with path for historical blobs, or ~1 when raw shell Git syntax is unavoidable. Use move_file to relocate or rename workspace files instead of shell move or mv.

config_schema.label: Terminal commands
config_schema.help_text: Send-time preference: allow the model to run shell commands. Availability still requires a workspace root.

command.description: The command to execute using cmd.exe syntax on Windows or POSIX /bin/sh syntax elsewhere.

run_in_background.description: Run the command in the background and return a job_id.

expected_exit_codes.description: Explicit acceptable exits. Supersedes zero and semantic-exit handling; incompatible with background execution.

purpose.description: One short plain sentence explaining what will happen in the user's terms.

tools.name: run_temp_script
tools.description: Run an automatically cleaned-up platform shell script outside the repository. Uses cmd.exe on Windows and /bin/sh elsewhere; background mode is not supported. Pass language to run the script under a specific interpreter instead of the platform shell.

language.description: Interpreter language for the temporary script.

cwd.description: Working directory override within the workspace.

purpose.description: One short plain sentence explaining what will happen in the user's terms.

tools.name: monitor
tools.description: Start a bounded shell-snippet monitor that streams later events back to the session.

purpose.description: One short plain sentence explaining what will happen in the user's terms.

description.description: Short user-visible description of what the monitor watches.

persistent.description: Persist the monitor record for record-only recovery after restart.

cwd.description: Working directory override within the tools workspace root.

match_patterns.description: Only surface output lines matching ANY of these regexes (include filter, case-insensitive). Omit/empty to surface all lines.

ignore_patterns.description: Suppress output lines matching ANY of these regexes (exclude filter, case-insensitive).

dedupe.description: Collapse consecutive identical output lines into a single event.

tools.name: check_background_job
tools.description: Check status and output of a background shell job.

job_id.description: The exact 12-character lowercase hexadecimal job_id returned by run_command with run_in_background.

tools.name: stop_background_job
tools.description: Stop an active background shell job owned by the current workspace and return its terminal status. Repeating the call for an already terminal job is safe.

purpose.description: One short plain sentence explaining what will happen in the user's terms.

job_id.description: The exact 12-character lowercase hexadecimal job_id returned by run_command with run_in_background.

tools.name: check_monitor
tools.description: Pull new matching events from a running or finished monitor since a cursor, with suppressed/total counts and state.

monitor_id.description: The monitor_id returned by a prior monitor call.

since_sequence.description: Return only events with sequence greater than this cursor. Omit or 0 for all retained events.

wait_ms.description: Block up to this many ms for new events or monitor completion. Default 0 returns immediately.

tools.name: todo_write
tools.description: Replace the in-session todo list atomically.

purpose.description: One short plain sentence explaining what will happen in the user's terms.

tools.name: todo_read
tools.description: Read the current in-session todo list. When a plan has been approved for this session, the response also includes the active plan under `plan`.

tools.name: connections_list
tools.description: List the online services this session is configured to use so the user can decide before sharing sensitive information. Reads configuration only and never probes the network.

tools.name: mermaid_generate
tools.description: Generate a Mermaid diagram that renders as a chart directly in the chat reply and is also saved as a reusable .mmd artifact for the session. Write the complete Mermaid source (diagram type declaration plus all nodes and connections) in the prompt parameter. The chart appears inline in the conversation; do not tell the user to look in a side panel, and do not repeat the Mermaid source in your reply.

prompt.description: The complete Mermaid diagram source to render, including the diagram type header (e.g. flowchart TD) and all content. The validated diagram is rendered inline in the conversation and saved as a .mmd artifact.

diagram_type.description: Optional Mermaid diagram type. Defaults to flowchart.

render_hint.description: Optional rendering hint for the UI.

tools.name: lsp
tools.description: Language-server code intelligence for a workspace file: action selects diagnostics, symbols, definition, or references (current document text is synchronized first). definition and references require line and character.

config_schema.label: LSP code intelligence
config_schema.help_text: Enable read-only language-server diagnostics, document symbols, definitions, and references.

path.description: Workspace-relative or absolute file path to inspect.

line.description: Zero-based line number. Required for definition and references.

character.description: Zero-based UTF-16 character offset. Required for definition and references.

max_diagnostics.description: diagnostics action: maximum diagnostics to return.

max_symbols.description: symbols action: maximum symbols to return.

max_locations.description: definition action: maximum definition locations to return. Defaults to 20.

include_declaration.description: references action: include the symbol declaration in the results. Defaults to false.

max_references.description: references action: maximum references to return. Defaults to 100.

tools.name: exit_plan_mode
tools.description: Submit the completed implementation plan for review and, when approved, leave Plan Mode and continue execution in the same turn.

tools.name: ask_user
tools.description: Ask the user one to four structured questions and wait for their answers before continuing the turn.

tools.name: jenny_status
tools.description: Return Jenny's current read-only status across backend, runtime, harness, logs, cost, schemas, automations, and budget posture. Diagnostic only; do not use this to answer source-code or repository architecture questions.

session_id.description: Optional session id for session-scoped cost details.

recent_log_limit.description: Maximum number of recent log entries and warning/error samples to include.

include_harness.description: Whether to include the internal harness inspection facet. Defaults to true.

tools.name: tool_search
tools.description: Search for available tools by keyword query. Use this when you need a tool that is not in your current tool list.

query.description: Search query. Use 'select:ToolName' for exact match or keywords for fuzzy search. Prefix with + for required terms.

tools.name: load_skill
tools.description: Load the full SKILL.md body for a skill shown under "Available Skills" in the system prompt, by its name and scope. Required before following an indexed skill's instructions.

name.description: The skill's relative directory id as shown in the "Available Skills" index (the load_skill(name=..., scope=...) call in that entry), not its human-readable title.

scope.description: Optional: the scope shown alongside the skill in the index. Disambiguates when the same name exists in more than one scope; omitted searches bundled, then user, then project.
